Interface Frames

public interface Frames
Opens frame views in frames of their own, and tracks them. Every method is called on the EDT.

Each frame gets a window scope and a view scope of its own, under the root injector: a frame never belongs to the view that opened it. Closing a frame asks the exit vetoes of its scopes first; closing the last frame of a MultiFrame application requests exit.

      <V extends FrameView, E extends Enum<E>> V open(Class<V> type, E variant)
      Opens a frame showing a variant of a view: its resources merge the variant's table over the base table.
      Type Parameters:
      V - the view class
      E - the enum of the variants
      Parameters:
      type - the view class
      variant - the variant, a constant of the @Variants enum nested in the view class
      Returns:
      the view, once its frame is shown
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the enum of variant is not nested in type
      IllegalStateException - if the resources have no table for the variant
